reviews: Shared reversible ownership, isolated policy boundaries, native sender exceptions and settings rollback.
Bounded text/node/action scans, adjacent text boundaries, overlapping prompt policies and iframe allocation reduction.
Protection status, all package consumers, rendered controls, regression criteria, source hashes and documentation.
limits: Recognizable English dialogs and fixed overlays only; no live scam sites tested.
Notification hooks require reload and do not revoke already granted permissions or existing subscriptions.
Cross-origin frames, workers, restricted pages, closed shadow roots and deliberate hook evasion are not guaranteed coverage.
Existing granted permission behavior was unit-tested; real OS desktop notifications were not exercised.
